Histamines in wine are natural compounds formed mainly during fermentation and winemaking, and they are often blamed for wine intolerance symptoms like flushing, nasal congestion, headaches, or digestive upset—though clinical evidence on whether wine's histamine content alone drives these reactions is mixed.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1yRPeuaAf4ip49cw8pxIvKTOSgeH41xdng7WBA-lJvAclLYLI8SAadwpLFUdjNyPAakX6_jWS0qRWdbyhB4OALs5RcJUanOtSAIkpPW8V0Tos7b-ywnmhQNMWZkvui8UfGD7yHdYM6lxibF1HraiuHvL11lHMchCATceubeAAv2oZk4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF1wNjaD5KbAUFxbXhz5R9VpZe0wkjWbctmlTU0Jr8mCDIOLO6W2FnQtEGGf_4sGsPjtLIJGPwHXtQ12n6uinBeknw_rRnXY8SLQ64mi2eRIyy3xWYM1sFidp35rjjK2HuY4NLoSW9YZbf_vfqlWFyEgz2hIPs7Q9NUoilSg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESngEBxCJF1yrHTJUU8L5wt6fcQE4AhrGsIoh6ZYI6p8o2dvcp6q5YjG6awrWyjGlkRedaXBDRR3uHWmMzmjAXNzszY0RiuzIuKA5iksTO7yPqjQtUeD3N9riuwfBrqLAVxWdFLga3U2yMNql0TYfajYyuMcF-MPtW9ohAcG99ir-ae14bi3CbrfcWa0FeJos9qgWBGGWUk5CCQp92zBV5og)

### How Histamines Form in Wine

- **Fermentation and skin contact:** Histamine is produced by bacteria (such as lactic acid bacteria during malolactic fermentation) converting the amino acid histidine.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXM04wjokSVY1eEi6kA4GDMGFLbDq3WeG3jSWz6ik2mAafUAlB_LFM0ngvCigUgwwmy-RPFYPQcpilPHO6kjBbJFzmH5asts4eYhtQxTRkCNybPhe57LrA5NEOQWReOt--sM98X4ntt164mLeLH7RjyjI4tgz4i54)
- **Red vs. white wine:** Red wines typically contain higher histamine levels than white wines because of prolonged skin contact during fermentation and more frequent malolactic fermentation or oak aging.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF1-AukH1jQsKQ0wTK0DVFxrCZ0_Xc348p_mYJpEeMPvu7tL5twAez7NWm5GRD7NdgT9lP07851TwprL7I7By8Cgove9WGQVH8gSqENAMQm2e3KTS8QI3kPlOWhz3s3xg7ynftn9CcAzGrH3D8PTdKEQ9620oe-adTqyrmApXcZd2UDkb6FP8hlGMUtN5NXctDHtaY)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1yRPeuaAf4ip49cw8pxIvKTOSgeH41xdng7WBA-lJvAclLYLI8SAadwpLFUdjNyPAakX6_jWS0qRWdbyhB4OALs5RcJUanOtSAIkpPW8V0Tos7b-ywnmhQNMWZkvui8UfGD7yHdYM6lxibF1HraiuHvL11lHMchCATceubeAAv2oZk4)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXM04wjokSVY1eEi6kA4GDMGFLbDq3WeG3jSWz6ik2mAafUAlB_LFM0ngvCigUgwwmy-RPFYPQcpilPHO6kjBbJFzmH5asts4eYhtQxTRkCNybPhe57LrA5NEOQWReOt--sM98X4ntt164mLeLH7RjyjI4tgz4i54)
- **Levels vary widely:** No wine is strictly zero-histamine, and concentrations vary substantially by style, winemaking practices, and bottle.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXXmLioX1TQGAKvsgO3bR7WffkZZFFTbVaHS5iX6kNBOILYRnknqbAtWxG0JLft9FtTkBiMtHX_RZeoB5zg8q7ZClSPhcoKu__LVoaW4z4S-HxkL9NbgixKwL7LiZRxDA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1yRPeuaAf4ip49cw8pxIvKTOSgeH41xdng7WBA-lJvAclLYLI8SAadwpLFUdjNyPAakX6_jWS0qRWdbyhB4OALs5RcJUanOtSAIkpPW8V0Tos7b-ywnmhQNMWZkvui8UfGD7yHdYM6lxibF1HraiuHvL11lHMchCATceubeAAv2oZk4)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXM04wjokSVY1eEi6kA4GDMGFLbDq3WeG3jSWz6ik2mAafUAlB_LFM0ngvCigUgwwmy-RPFYPQcpilPHO6kjBbJFzmH5asts4eYhtQxTRkCNybPhe57LrA5NEOQWReOt--sM98X4ntt164mLeLH7RjyjI4tgz4i54)

### How Histamine Affects the Body

- **Enzyme breakdown:** The body normally breaks down ingested histamine using enzymes like diamine oxidase (DAO). Alcohol can inhibit DAO and increase gut absorption, raising histamine load.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESngEBxCJF1yrHTJUU8L5wt6fcQE4AhrGsIoh6ZYI6p8o2dvcp6q5YjG6awrWyjGlkRedaXBDRR3uHWmMzmjAXNzszY0RiuzIuKA5iksTO7yPqjQtUeD3N9riuwfBrqLAVxWdFLga3U2yMNql0TYfajYyuMcF-MPtW9ohAcG99ir-ae14bi3CbrfcWa0FeJos9qgWBGGWUk5CCQp92zBV5og)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXXmLioX1TQGAKvsgO3bR7WffkZZFFTbVaHS5iX6kNBOILYRnknqbAtWxG0JLft9FtTkBiMtHX_RZeoB5zg8q7ZClSPhcoKu__LVoaW4z4S-HxkL9NbgixKwL7LiZRxDA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1yRPeuaAf4ip49cw8pxIvKTOSgeH41xdng7WBA-lJvAclLYLI8SAadwpLFUdjNyPAakX6_jWS0qRWdbyhB4OALs5RcJUanOtSAIkpPW8V0Tos7b-ywnmhQNMWZkvui8UfGD7yHdYM6lxibF1HraiuHvL11lHMchCATceubeAAv2oZk4)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF1-AukH1jQsKQ0wTK0DVFxrCZ0_Xc348p_mYJpEeMPvu7tL5twAez7NWm5GRD7NdgT9lP07851TwprL7I7By8Cgove9WGQVH8gSqENAMQm2e3KTS8QI3kPlOWhz3s3xg7ynftn9CcAzGrH3D8PTdKEQ9620oe-adTqyrmApXcZd2UDkb6FP8hlGMUtN5NXctDHtaY)
- **Debated role in reactions:** While some provocation research links wine intolerance to histamine, other clinical trials—such as findings published in the [Journal of Allergy and Clinical Immunology](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF1wNjaD5KbAUFxbXhz5R9VpZe0wkjWbctmlTU0Jr8mCDIOLO6W2FnQtEGGf_4sGsPjtLIJGPwHXtQ12n6uinBeknw_rRnXY8SLQ64mi2eRIyy3xWYM1sFidp35rjjK2HuY4NLoSW9YZbf_vfqlWFyEgz2hIPs7Q9NUoilSg) —have found no direct correlation between a wine's histamine level and adverse symptoms, pointing to other factors like alcohol itself, acetaldehyde, tannins, other biogenic amines, or dehydration.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF1wNjaD5KbAUFxbXhz5R9VpZe0wkjWbctmlTU0Jr8mCDIOLO6W2FnQtEGGf_4sGsPjtLIJGPwHXtQ12n6uinBeknw_rRnXY8SLQ64mi2eRIyy3xWYM1sFidp35rjjK2HuY4NLoSW9YZbf_vfqlWFyEgz2hIPs7Q9NUoilSg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXXmLioX1TQGAKvsgO3bR7WffkZZFFTbVaHS5iX6kNBOILYRnknqbAtWxG0JLft9FtTkBiMtHX_RZeoB5zg8q7ZClSPhcoKu__LVoaW4z4S-HxkL9NbgixKwL7LiZRxDA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESngEBxCJF1yrHTJUU8L5wt6fcQE4AhrGsIoh6ZYI6p8o2dvcp6q5YjG6awrWyjGlkRedaXBDRR3uHWmMzmjAXNzszY0RiuzIuKA5iksTO7yPqjQtUeD3N9riuwfBrqLAVxWdFLga3U2yMNql0TYfajYyuMcF-MPtW9ohAcG99ir-ae14bi3CbrfcWa0FeJos9qgWBGGWUk5CCQp92zBV5og)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXM04wjokSVY1eEi6kA4GDMGFLbDq3WeG3jSWz6ik2mAafUAlB_LFM0ngvCigUgwwmy-RPFYPQcpilPHO6kjBbJFzmH5asts4eYhtQxTRkCNybPhe57LrA5NEOQWReOt--sM98X4ntt164mLeLH7RjyjI4tgz4i54)
- **Allergy vs. intolerance:** True allergies to wine ingredients (such as grapes or yeast) or alcohol itself are less common than intolerance or sensitivity, though severe allergic reactions require urgent medical care.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF1__UuTzw7a8StcMWzN36D4TL9wquKcQiMIKATrRYA8I1KV5lyXQtwwlJ2KJ_25By02ONpdzuEfBq3FMcWbOyeNBwb754ujgrJB9n-s8s16McWUyrG7VcpshcyRYiyoaw77QQjV1P1mLHzJ9wZUby51kuI6CrXNs9T0fk5Gb94Q2kk5TDPOo03lmY5g)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF1-AukH1jQsKQ0wTK0DVFxrCZ0_Xc348p_mYJpEeMPvu7tL5twAez7NWm5GRD7NdgT9lP07851TwprL7I7By8Cgove9WGQVH8gSqENAMQm2e3KTS8QI3kPlOWhz3s3xg7ynftn9CcAzGrH3D8PTdKEQ9620oe-adTqyrmApXcZd2UDkb6FP8hlGMUtN5NXctDHtaY)

### Practical Ways to Lower Risk

- **Choose styles carefully:** Lighter, young white wines aged in stainless steel (such as Riesling or Grüner Veltliner) or rosé often have lower histamine risk than heavy, oak-aged reds. For more guidance on winemaking factors and retail tips, see [ProWein](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1yRPeuaAf4ip49cw8pxIvKTOSgeH41xdng7WBA-lJvAclLYLI8SAadwpLFUdjNyPAakX6_jWS0qRWdbyhB4OALs5RcJUanOtSAIkpPW8V0Tos7b-ywnmhQNMWZkvui8UfGD7yHdYM6lxibF1HraiuHvL11lHMchCATceubeAAv2oZk4).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1yRPeuaAf4ip49cw8pxIvKTOSgeH41xdng7WBA-lJvAclLYLI8SAadwpLFUdjNyPAakX6_jWS0qRWdbyhB4OALs5RcJUanOtSAIkpPW8V0Tos7b-ywnmhQNMWZkvui8UfGD7yHdYM6lxibF1HraiuHvL11lHMchCATceubeAAv2oZk4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF1-AukH1jQsKQ0wTK0DVFxrCZ0_Xc348p_mYJpEeMPvu7tL5twAez7NWm5GRD7NdgT9lP07851TwprL7I7By8Cgove9WGQVH8gSqENAMQm2e3KTS8QI3kPlOWhz3s3xg7ynftn9CcAzGrH3D8PTdKEQ9620oe-adTqyrmApXcZd2UDkb6FP8hlGMUtN5NXctDHtaY)
- **Pace and hydrate:** Drink water alongside wine, avoid drinking on an empty stomach, and keep portions small to see how your body responds.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF1-AukH1jQsKQ0wTK0DVFxrCZ0_Xc348p_mYJpEeMPvu7tL5twAez7NWm5GRD7NdgT9lP07851TwprL7I7By8Cgove9WGQVH8gSqENAMQm2e3KTS8QI3kPlOWhz3s3xg7ynftn9CcAzGrH3D8PTdKEQ9620oe-adTqyrmApXcZd2UDkb6FP8hlGMUtN5NXctDHtaY)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESngEBxCJF1yrHTJUU8L5wt6fcQE4AhrGsIoh6ZYI6p8o2dvcp6q5YjG6awrWyjGlkRedaXBDRR3uHWmMzmjAXNzszY0RiuzIuKA5iksTO7yPqjQtUeD3N9riuwfBrqLAVxWdFLga3U2yMNql0TYfajYyuMcF-MPtW9ohAcG99ir-ae14bi3CbrfcWa0FeJos9qgWBGGWUk5CCQp92zBV5og)
- **Watch for severe symptoms:** Seek medical evaluation if you experience hives, wheezing, shortness of breath, dizziness, or swelling after drinking wine.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF1-AukH1jQsKQ0wTK0DVFxrCZ0_Xc348p_mYJpEeMPvu7tL5twAez7NWm5GRD7NdgT9lP07851TwprL7I7By8Cgove9WGQVH8gSqENAMQm2e3KTS8QI3kPlOWhz3s3xg7ynftn9CcAzGrH3D8PTdKEQ9620oe-adTqyrmApXcZd2UDkb6FP8hlGMUtN5NXctDHtaY)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF1__UuTzw7a8StcMWzN36D4TL9wquKcQiMIKATrRYA8I1KV5lyXQtwwlJ2KJ_25By02ONpdzuEfBq3FMcWbOyeNBwb754ujgrJB9n-s8s16McWUyrG7VcpshcyRYiyoaw77QQjV1P1mLHzJ9wZUby51kuI6CrXNs9T0fk5Gb94Q2kk5TDPOo03lmY5g)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX63eOdfrRexdAK5gUm6QBclMhAeV43ar4AKMsJfl-atBO9bqG11oeLHVOMoO-ZiGbx5b3HDdzUQAl5PT10MU8e-njgI9DJyZpzNGoqmvR6hUPPcqsfQn2JPs3a26Y6wOQADT0b7po)

- **Debated role in reactions:** While some provocation research links wine intolerance to histamine, other clinical trials—such as findings published in the [Journal of Allergy and Clinical Immunology](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF1wNjaD5KbAUFxbXhz5R9VpZe0wkjWbctmlTU0Jr8mCDIOLO6W2FnQtEGGf_4sGsPjtLIJGPwHXtQ12n6uinBeknw_rRnXY8SLQ64mi2eRIyy3xWYM1sFidp35rjjK2HuY4NLoSW9YZbf_vfqlWFyEgz2hIPs7Q9NUoilSg) —have found no direct correlation between a wine's histamine level and adverse symptoms, pointing to other factors like alcohol itself, acetaldehyde, tannins, other biogenic amines, or dehydration.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF1wNjaD5KbAUFxbXhz5R9VpZe0wkjWbctmlTU0Jr8mCDIOLO6W2FnQtEGGf_4sGsPjtLIJGPwHXtQ12n6uinBeknw_rRnXY8SLQ64mi2eRIyy3xWYM1sFidp35rjjK2HuY4NLoSW9YZbf_vfqlWFyEgz2hIPs7Q9NUoilSg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXXmLioX1TQGAKvsgO3bR7WffkZZFFTbVaHS5iX6kNBOILYRnknqbAtWxG0JLft9FtTkBiMtHX_RZeoB5zg8q7ZClSPhcoKu__LVoaW4z4S-HxkL9NbgixKwL7LiZRxDA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESngEBxCJF1yrHTJUU8L5wt6fcQE4AhrGsIoh6ZYI6p8o2dvcp6q5YjG6awrWyjGlkRedaXBDRR3uHWmMzmjAXNzszY0RiuzIuKA5iksTO7yPqjQtUeD3N9riuwfBrqLAVxWdFLga3U2yMNql0TYfajYyuMcF-MPtW9ohAcG99ir-ae14bi3CbrfcWa0FeJos9qgWBGGWUk5CCQp92zBV5og)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXM04wjokSVY1eEi6kA4GDMGFLbDq3WeG3jSWz6ik2mAafUAlB_LFM0ngvCigUgwwmy-RPFYPQcpilPHO6kjBbJFzmH5asts4eYhtQxTRkCNybPhe57LrA5NEOQWReOt--sM98X4ntt164mLeLH7RjyjI4tgz4i54)
- **Allergy vs. intolerance:** True allergies to wine ingredients (such as grapes or yeast) or alcohol itself are less common than intolerance or sensitivity, though severe allergic reactions require urgent medical care.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF1__UuTzw7a8StcMWzN36D4TL9wquKcQiMIKATrRYA8I1KV5lyXQtwwlJ2KJ_25By02ONpdzuEfBq3FMcWbOyeNBwb754ujgrJB9n-s8s16McWUyrG7VcpshcyRYiyoaw77QQjV1P1mLHzJ9wZUby51kuI6CrXNs9T0fk5Gb94Q2kk5TDPOo03lmY5g)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF1-AukH1jQsKQ0wTK0DVFxrCZ0_Xc348p_mYJpEeMPvu7tL5twAez7NWm5GRD7NdgT9lP07851TwprL7I7By8Cgove9WGQVH8gSqENAMQm2e3KTS8QI3kPlOWhz3s3xg7ynftn9CcAzGrH3D8PTdKEQ9620oe-adTqyrmApXcZd2UDkb6FP8hlGMUtN5NXctDHtaY)

items.title: Practical Ways to Lower Risk
items.text: Choose styles carefully: Lighter, young white wines aged in stainless steel (such as Riesling or Grüner Veltliner) or rosé often have lower histamine risk than heavy, oak-aged reds. For more guidance on winemaking factors and retail tips, see ProWein. Pace and hydrate: Drink water alongside wine, avoid drinking on an empty stomach, and keep portions small to see how your body responds. Watch for severe symptoms: Seek medical evaluation if you experience hives, wheezing, shortness of breath, dizziness, or swelling after drinking wine.
